2021_185_feb_2021_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's purchasing-card (PCARD) report for February 2021, printed 4/14/2021 and placed on the Board of Education agenda for the April 20, 2021 meeting, itemizes every district card charge and credit posted under the journal entry "FEB PCARD EXP." Transactions are dated from 1/26/2021 through 2/25/2021 and run across 18 pages, each line coded to a budget unit and an account code. The report closes with a Subtotal of 131,198.47 in transaction amounts and 1,064.96 in credits, and a stated Total Expenses of 130,133.51.

Overview

Each line lists a transaction description (charge date plus abbreviated merchant name), the journal entry "FEB PCARD EXP," a budget unit, an account code, a transaction amount and a credits column.
